from pathlib import Path
import ast
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/home/joshua/lonely-runner-formalization')
manifest = json.loads(Path('/tmp/astra-pass77-inputs.json').read_text())
for name, digest in (manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes']).items():
    data = (root / name).read_bytes()
    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == digest, name
    assert data.endswith(b'\n'), name
    assert all(line.rstrip() == line for line in data.splitlines()), name
for review, inputs in manifest['review_bindings'].items():
    content = (root / review).read_text()
    for name in inputs:
        digest = (manifest['hashes'] | manifest['dependency_hashes'])[name]
        assert digest in content, (review, name)
source = (root / 'research/astra-harmonic-fold-control.py').read_text()
ast.parse(source)
receipt = json.loads((root / 'research/astra-harmonic-fold-control.json').read_text())
assert source == receipt['execution']['source_utf8']
assert hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() == receipt['execution']['source_sha256']
assert receipt['observed_tool_result']['observed_exit_code'] == 0
assert receipt['observed_tool_result']['chunk_id'] == '26f718'
assert receipt['observed_tool_result']['separately_captured_stderr'] is None
observed = json.loads(receipt['observed_tool_result']['full_combined_output'])
assert observed['checked_tuple_count'] == 33 and observed['counterexample_found'] is True
assert observed['stop_reason'] == 'first_all_choice_failure'
assert receipt['focused_regressions']['status'] == 'passed'
assert receipt['result']['counterexample']['v'] == [1, 6, 12]
assert receipt['result']['counterexample']['all_global_maximizing_times'] == ['7/18', '4/9']
old = json.loads((root / 'research/astra-harmonic-fold-control-initial.json').read_text())
assert hashlib.sha256(old['execution']['source_utf8'].encode()).hexdigest() == old['execution']['source_sha256']
commands = []
for argv in ([sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/validate_workflow.py'],
             ['git', 'diff', '--check'],
             [sys.executable, '-B', 'scripts/manage_storage.py']):
    result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)
    commands.append({'argv': argv, 'exit_code': result.returncode,
                     'stdout': result.stdout, 'stderr': result.stderr})
    assert result.returncode == 0, commands[-1]
print(json.dumps({'frozen_files': len(manifest['hashes']),
                  'dependency_bindings': len(manifest['dependency_hashes']),
                  'review_bindings': sum(map(len, manifest['review_bindings'].values())),
                  'numerical_replay': False, 'commands': commands}, indent=2))
